[[Glob of Dark Matter]] is a type of [[crafting material]] required for creating [[ascended equipment]].

== Acquisition ==
* [[Salvage|Salvaging]] high level [[exotic]] gear yields between 0 and 3 Globs of Dark Matter. Using a [[Master's Salvage Kit]], the estimated average is ~0.5 globs per exotic for exotic gear level 68 or better.<ref>[http://www.reddit.com/r/Guildwars2/comments/1uzvm7/dark_matter_rate_1765_exotics/ Reddit post]</ref> Using a [[Black Lion Salvage Kit]], the estimated average is ~1 glob per exotic for exotic gear level 68 or higher.<ref>[https://forum-en.gw2archive.eu/forum/game/gw2/Glob-of-Dark-Matter-drop-rate/first#post4925596 Forum post: Glob of Dark Matter drop rate]</ref>
